description: Expander for MIDI-CAT, placed immediately to the right of it, adding fine adjustment of the parameters MIDI-CAT has mapped.

inputs.text: While this gate is high, a mapped MIDI control moves its parameter within a 10% range, once that control has been returned to its centre.
While this gate is high, a mapped MIDI control moves its parameter within a 1, 2 or 5% range, once that control has been returned to its centre.

notes: fine adjustment works on CC mappings whose input mode is Pickup (snap) or Pickup (jump).
with the ten percent gate high, raising the finer gate narrows the range without the control being centred again.
menu: Higher precision range — 1%, 2% or 5%, the range the second gate input works over.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
